title: The Poles: easier to grab Pola, one-tap pictures
kaylee: Pola is much easier to grab on the ice, and the pictures on the globe's trail open on the first tap.

pictures.title: Ice Floe Hop: where her finger grabs Pola (pink)
pictures.caption: On an iPad the grab circle went from 122 px to 209 px across (an iPhone gets a bit less). It stays small while Pola swims, so it never blocks pushing the summer floes.
